title: Hardcoded Resource Directories
pattern: Hardcoding specific file descriptor paths, operating system pseudofiles, or system directories deep in core code.
why_bad: Renders the system completely non-portable. It causes execution failures across different operating systems, kernel versions, or container environments that configure mount hierarchies differently.
detection: Core parsing or diagnostic modules accessing hardcoded linux-specific namespaces (such as raw `/proc` or `/sys` targets) directly.
fix: Expose the resource root paths as configuration parameters; fall back to system standard paths but permit override overrides for alternate testing.
source: Gregg, Brendan - *Systems Performance_ Enterprise and the Cloud* (2013, Pearson Education Limited (US titles)_Prentice Hall).pdf, Chapter 4.
